title: Annotatio IV §.I: Divide obstacles into Externos and Internos
pass_a_gloss: We divide them (a) into Externals, or those placed outside the man, and into Internals, or those domestic to the man.
pass_b_english: We divide them, first, into Externals — placed outside the person — and Internals — at home in the person.
source_text: Herciscimus a. eos in Externos, seu extra hominem positos, & in Internos, seu homini domesticos.
